questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in the following sentence: 'Had he known the consequences, he ________ the risky investment.'
options: wouldn't make
wouldn't have made
wouldn't be making
wouldn't have been making

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical wish?
options: I wish that I was taller.
I wish that I were taller.
I wish that I am taller.
I wish that I be taller.
questions.answer: I wish that I were taller.

questions.question: Select the option that demonstrates a correct use of ellipsis in formal writing.
options: We discussed the matter yesterday. We decided to postpone it.
We discussed the matter yesterday. We decided to postpone it.
We discussed the matter yesterday. We decided to postpone it.
We discussed the matter yesterday. We decided to postpone it.
questions.answer: We discussed the matter yesterday. We decided to postpone it.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly employs a cleft sentence to emphasize the location?
options: It was in London that the conference was held.
It was in London that the conference was held.
It was in London that the conference was held.
It was in London that the conference was held.
questions.answer: It was in London that the conference was held.

questions.question: Choose the correct form to complete the sentence: 'If only we ________ all the problems we have now.'
options: didn't have
hadn't had
don't have
haven't had
